modules: Tafseer Of Sūrahs Az-Zilzalah And Al-Cādiyāt
Sūrah Al - Qāricah And Sūrah At-
mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is used because it is the seat of all his thoughts.
The heart is used because it is the seat of all his thoughts.
Fill in the blank: ______ is the one which draws him to his Lord while the clay glues him to the earth.
The spirit is the one which draws him to his Lord while the clay glues him to the earth.
Fill in the blank: ______ is the elevating path through which upright human nature ascends to its ultimate perfection.
Faith is the elevating path through which upright human nature ascends to its ultimate perfection.
fib: ______ is the crux of the matter; that is the reason for the oath.
The fourth verse is the crux of the matter; that is the reason for the oath.
______ are the roots of his misfortunes, and not the period or place…An illustration of this is corruption which has eaten deep into the fabrics of our polity, religion, economy, etc.
The deeds of man are the roots of his misfortunes, and not the period or place…An illustration of this is corruption which has eaten deep into the fabrics of our polity, religion, economy, etc.
